answer: Tie earning to a bond that must sit idle at a wharf of locked capital for a random, unknown number of future epochs before an audit releases it; you cannot predict when your own unlock fires. One honest agent posts a single bond and waits, patient as yarrow. A farm wanting a thousand live heads must moor a thousand bonds through their whole unknown windows, since capital cannot be recycled head-to-head when each unlock time is independent. The opportunity cost of a thousand idle bonds, each tied for an unpredictable span, climbs the vine past what the fakes could earn.
